serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Where did he go?
Shanice: Bunch of people came here not so long ago, acting all cocky.
Shanice: They wanted to wreck the place so me and Priestcan were laying in wait, but all of sudden one of them said…
Shanice: ‘Let’s go somewhere else! Someone already fucked this place up before us’.
Shanice: Priestcan got all mad about it and went after them.
You: Will he be alright?
Shanice: I think so. He got a bunch of new weapons when we were in the Vatican.
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceHappy
Shanice: Oops! That was supposed to be a secret!
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceNormal
Shanice: Don’t tell anyone about it, ok? Especially customs at the airport. They tend to be pretty sensitive about stuff like that for some reason.
You: Y-yeah, no problem…
You: Will you be alright on your own though? It’s very dangerous outside.
#Nun_NewOutfit.Eyes.Normal+Nun_NewOutfit.Mouth.Smile
Shanice: No problem! I have my loyal broom at my disposal, after all.
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceNormal
You: Yeah, sure. Just make sure to call Priestbot if someone dangerous comes around.
